set.selection_process: No single CUET merit list. Each university decides which CUET subject combination counts for each programme and runs its own counselling (DU: CSAS; BHU, AU, UoH etc.: own portals). DU (2026): BMS / BBA (FIA) = one language + Maths/Applied Maths + one List B subject + General Aptitude Test (SSCBS FAQ). B.Com (Hons) = one language + Maths/Applied Maths or Accountancy + two subjects, best combination counts. BA (Hons) Economics = one language + Maths/Applied Maths + two subjects. B.Com (pass) = language + 3 subjects OR language + 1 subject + General Aptitude Test. Class XII marks are used only for tie-breaks at DU. St. Stephen's minority seats add an interview (85% CUET + 15% interview). BA (Hons) Business Economics (BBE) = one language (List A) + Maths/Applied Maths + General Aptitude Test (PW 2026 table; Careers360). In 2026 BBE was offered at 5 DU colleges: Aryabhatta, College of Vocational Studies, Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar, Gargi (W), Lakshmibai (W) (DU seat matrix); SSCBS does not offer it.
